UNDERSTAND THE MODEL

Evidence before precision.

Numerical correctness and aircraft accuracy are different questions.

Calibration

Fuel burn is fitted to Boeing's published payload/range chart.

The raw OpenAP model flies about 29% less far than Boeing's 777-300ER chart (airport-planning document D6-58329, Rev G). One fuel-flow factor, 0.708, brings twelve chart points within 22 nmi RMS. It assumes a 5% contingency reserve; 0% or 10% would give 0.754 or 0.667.

This matches Boeing's design-level range, not measured airline fuel flow. It does not tell drag errors from engine errors, so displayed drag and lift-to-drag ratio are still OpenAP's.

Temperature affects the atmosphere and speed. Direct engine-temperature effects, wave drag and buffet are not modeled. Thrust availability is an ISA reference.
